**Finding submitted: deviation (§ 7.2, p0026).**

- **What it says:** "Before engaging another provider, Customer must disclose and match for Vendor any more favourable commercial offer it receives."
- **Direction:** The MFN binds *us*, not Cobalt Cloud. This is the wrong direction under the rule — a Vendor-granted MFN would have been compliant.
- **Why it fails the fallback:** No product limitation, no 12-month sunset, no reasonable-comparison carve-outs. It captures every better offer we ever receive and forces disclosure of third-party pricing (confidentiality/antitrust exposure). That is walk-away territory, not fallback.
- **Internal inconsistency:** § 12.3 (p0044) has Vendor acknowledging we have made "no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment" — squarely at odds with § 7.2.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** delete p0026 in full; preferred position reached with the minimal edit.
